nodes.description: A patent (US9514753B2) describing methods, systems, and apparatus for performing speaker identification using hash-based indexing of speaker vectors.

A vector derived from an utterance, for which hash values are determined according to multiple different hash functions and which is compared with speaker vectors to select a speaker vector.<SEP>A vector derived from an utterance, used as the query representation in speaker identification; may be an i-vector or based on deep neural network activations.

A vector derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, used to characterize the speech of that speaker and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.<SEP>A vector derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, stored in hash tables and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.
Values determined for an utterance vector or speaker vector according to multiple different hash functions, used to look up speaker vectors in hash tables.
Multiple different functions used to compute hash values; may include locality sensitive hash functions or functions based on positions of vectors with respect to hyperplanes.
A plurality of tables storing speaker vectors indexed by hash values, from which a set of speaker vectors is determined.
A vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of an utterance or of one or more utterances of a speaker.
A network whose activations, occurring in response to information about an utterance, may be used to determine parameters of utterance and speaker vectors.
A type of hash function used to determine hash values for vectors in the speaker identification method.
Geometric constructs with respect to which the position of an utterance vector is used to determine hash values.
Scores each indicating a degree of similarity between the utterance vector and one of the speaker vectors in the set, used to select a speaker vector.
A measure of distance between the utterance vector and each speaker vector in the set, used to determine similarity scores.
A threshold value against which the smallest cosine distance is compared to decide whether to select a speaker vector.

An identity corresponding to a selected speaker vector, determined based on data indicating associations between speaker vectors and respective speakers, and output as data.<SEP>The identity of a speaker determined from the selected speaker vector, with data indicating the speaker identity being output.
Items that include utterances of a speaker corresponding to the selected speaker vector, which may be identified and indicated in output data.
A process of authenticating a particular user based at least in part on determining that the selected speaker vector corresponds to that particular user.
A set of multiple video resources from which speaker vectors may be generated for each resource.
A technique used to determine parameters of i-vectors from utterances.

A person whose speech characteristics are indicated by a speaker vector and to whom a speaker identity corresponds.<SEP>A person whose utterances are represented by speaker vectors and whose identity is determined through speaker identification.

Speech input from which an utterance vector is derived and from which speaker vectors are derived for a respective speaker.<SEP>Speech input from which an utterance vector is derived and whose speaker is to be identified.
One of a plurality of hash tables from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using hash values, each hash table being associated with a different hash value.
A value determined for an utterance vector according to multiple different hash functions, used to determine speaker vectors from a plurality of hash tables.
One of multiple different hash functions according to which hash values for an utterance vector are determined.
An utterance vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of the utterance.
A speaker vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of one or more utterances of a respective speaker.
A device storing instructions that, when executed by one or more computers, cause the computers to perform operations for speaker vector determination and selection.
One or more computers that execute instructions stored on a computer-readable storage device to perform operations.
One of a set of multiple video resources that is accessed and for which a speaker vector is generated.

A network service that enables developers to develop recommenders made available to content site operators for providing recommendations to end users, and that optimizes the use and selection of recommenders for different end users, groups, segments, content sites, and the like.

A website or content provider that requests item recommendations and event data storage from the personalization network service, and receives selected recommendations to present to end users.<SEP>A site that requests item recommendations from the recommendations system over a computer network via a network service interface, and that may provide recommender selections and weighting selections.

A software component or service that generates item recommendations, which may be developed by developers and registered with the recommendations service, including external recommenders operated by entities different from the personalization network service provider.<SEP>A component or service provided by a recommender provider that uses collected event data regarding user-generated events to select particular items to recommend to users, and provides scores that can be normalized and weighted.

A recommender provided by one or more entities that differ from the provider of the recommendations service, registered with the recommendations service and queried over a computer network for recommendations.

An entity or operator that develops and operates recommenders, separate from the operator of the personalization network service, and submits registration submissions for recommenders.<SEP>An entity that provides recommenders and submits registration submissions to request registration of the recommenders with a recommendations system; recommender providers are different entities than the provider of the recommendations system.
A person who develops recommenders that can be made available to content site operators through the personalization network service.
A user to whom recommendations are provided, and who generates events such as purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events.

A service within the personalization network service that registers external recommenders, provides access to event data, queries recommenders for recommendations, and selects a subset of recommendations to provide to content sites.

A component of the computer system operative to receive requests from a content site over a computer network, including requests to store event data and requests for item recommendations.<SEP>An interface over a computer network through which requests from content sites for item recommendations are received.
A repository comprising physical computer storage operative to store event data received from content sites, the event data describing user-generated events with identifiers of items and users.
A module configured to provide functionality for registering an external recommender with the recommendations service.
A component operative to provide access to event data to a plurality of external recommenders registered with the recommendations service.
A component of the recommendations service operative, in response to a request, to query external recommenders over the computer network and receive recommendations and associated scores.
A module configured to normalize associated scores, assign weights to external recommenders, and optimize recommendations based on user-generated events and previous content site requests.
Data descriptive of user-generated events, comprising identifiers of particular items and particular users to which the events correspond, stored in the event data repository.

Events generated by end users, including purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events, used to optimize and adjust recommendations and weights.<SEP>Events generated by users, comprising one or more of purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events, used by recommenders to select items to recommend.
Item recommendations generated by recommenders, received with associated scores, normalized, weighted, and selected as a subset to provide to content sites.
Scores associated with recommendations received from recommenders, which are normalized and combined with weights to produce overall scores for selecting recommendations.

Weights applied to recommenders or their recommendation results, which may be site-specific, user-specific, user segment-specific, or default, and are adjusted based on user-generated events.<SEP>Weights applied to each of the recommenders, which may be based on recommender performance and may be selected by content sites, and are combined with normalized scores to generate overall scores.

A system comprising computer hardware programmed to implement the network service interface, event data repository, registration module, data interface, recommendations service, and optimization module.
A network over which requests, event data, and recommendations are transmitted between content sites, the personalization network service, and external recommenders.
A patent publication titled "System for obtaining recommendations from multiple recommenders," describing a personalization network service and related systems and methods.

A computer-implemented system that registers recommenders from recommender providers, stores access information for the recommenders, receives requests from content sites for item recommendations, causes the recommenders to provide recommendations, normalizes scores, applies weights, and combines scores to generate overall recommendations.

A system comprising computer hardware operative to provide a service through which content sites obtain recommendations from a plurality of recommenders, responsive to requests by using network addresses to request recommendations and combining resulting recommendation sets.
A repository that stores information regarding a plurality of recommenders, including network addresses for accessing the recommenders on a network.
Scores provided by recommenders that have been normalized by the recommendations system.
Scores generated by combining normalized scores with weights, used in selecting recommendations to provide to content sites.
Network addresses, such as uniform resource indicators, for accessing the recommenders on a network.
Submissions operative to request registration of recommenders with a recommendations system, received from recommender providers.

Performance of each recommender in each of a plurality of contexts, comprising one or more of user-specific performance, segment-specific performance, and site-specific performance, used to determine how much weight to give to particular recommenders.
Descriptions of an external recommender that a provider of the external recommender is allowed to provide.

A method of providing a network service to content sites, performed by a computer system comprising computer hardware, involving receiving registration submissions, storing access information, receiving requests, causing recommenders to provide recommendations, normalizing scores, applying weights, and combining scores.
